why_the_variables: The same as the openpi environment: two launches of the openpi rows on one card were bit-identical only with deterministic GPU operations. This row samples with openpi's JAX code too; its own repeatability is not measured.

sources.what: RSS: an openpi fork with the guided π0.5 (models/pi0_cfg.py), its policy (policies/policy.py::CFGPolicy) and configs (training/misc/libero_cfg_config.py)

build: git clone https://github.com/Doo-mon/RSS && git -C RSS checkout f51a0a3f7373b35a61b0690696496066bb5616b8
the interpreter is RSS/.venv/bin/python; huggingface_hub must import (for the weights, see the row)
weights: snapshot_download("doomon/RSS_pi05_cfg_libero_caption", revision=<the row's>, allow_patterns=["pi05_cfg_libero_caption_exp1/29999/params/*", "pi05_cfg_libero_caption_exp1/29999/assets/*"]): 12.44 GB; train_state/ (32 GB) is not needed
